notes.title: 1.12 - Oops
notes.content:
1.12

Balance
Increased bullet speed
Lowered story rate

QoL
Improved autopilot -
- No delay between targets
- Dead ships wont find targets
- Changes targets on ship death
- Now works with multiple ships
- Also works with Uber Beam

Fixes
Some upgrades we getting re-locked: Now, loading the game after beating the first boss and transporting to Anubis (3rd world) will unlock all upgrades.
Even more typo fixing… will it ever end…
Last story parts will now play one after another, as intended

notes.title: 1.05 Released
notes.content:
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ArmanDoesStuff/comments/jm8s0z/prod_above_the_stars/]See future updates and give feedback here[/url]

[b]2020/11/06[/b]

[u]Features[/u]
    Added 25x buy
    Cargo value based on enemy (to keep it relevant)
    Mute game when out of focus
    Add new bullet model for 4th upgrade

[u]Balance[/u]
    Rebalance cargo
    Ark reset money based off planet level, not citizens
    Player/enemy Balance Changes
    Upgrade Balance/Cost Changes
    Lower health regen on death
    Change ark transport level

[u]Bugs[/u]
    Resolution gets reset in some cases
    Find and plug late game memory leak... oh god why
    Boss bar stays after boss death

[u]Other[/u]
    Add update screen/patch notes on first login
    Reorder resolution list
    Improve sound effects (menu, enemy destroy)

notes.title: 1.04 released
notes.content:
The launch has been great! The support has been overwhelming. That said, it wouldn't be a professional release if it didn't include a pointless day-one patch!

Feedback is much appreciated. You can message me via Reddit with bugs, suggestions, or just comments in general. I plan to make a longer story/more bosses in order to up the playtime but until then, thanks for playing and have a great day!
https://www.reddit.com/r/ArmanDoesStuff/comments/jm8s0z/prod_above_the_stars/

[u]Features[/u]
[list] 
[*]Mouse movement option
[*]Temporary upgrades (exploding enemies, dividing bullets, etc) (introduced 1.03)
[/list]

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*]Stars not showing up
[*]Enemies moving inside planet
[*]Can click planet after level start
[/list]

[u]Other[/u]
[list]
[*]Clarified game and menu controls
[*]Clarified ship damage upgrade
[*]Can now use W to fire
[*]Now supports more resolutions
[/list]
